outcomeNote: A mishna: two tannaitic disputes are recorded without resolution, followed by two unattributed rulings.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַקּוֹרֵא אֶת שְׁמַע וְלֹא הִשְׁמִיעַ לְאׇזְנוֹ — יָצָא. רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר: לֹא יָצָא.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who recites Shema and did not» recite in a manner «audible to his own ear,» either because he read inaudibly or because he is deaf, «fulfilled» his obligation. «Rabbi Yosei says: He did not fulfill» his obligation.

segments.he: קָרָא וְלֹא דִּקְדֵּק בְּאוֹתִיּוֹתֶיהָ, רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר: יָצָא. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: לֹא יָצָא.
segments.en: «One who recited» Shema and «was not» sufficiently «precise in» his enunciation of «its letters, Rabbi Yosei says: He fulfilled» his obligation. «Rabbi Yehuda says: He did not fulfill» his obligation.

segments.he: הַקּוֹרֵא לְמַפְרֵעַ — לֹא יָצָא. קָרָא וְטָעָה — יַחְזוֹר לִמְקוֹם שֶׁטָּעָה.
segments.en: «One who recited» Shema «out of order,» meaning he did not read the verses sequentially, «he did not fulfill» his obligation. «One who recited and erred, should return to the place» in Shema «that he erred.»

moves.cueHe: הקורא את שמע ולא השמיע לאזנו
moves.summary: one who recited Shema without making it audible to his own ear has fulfilled his obligation
moves.about: whether one who recited Shema without making it audible to his own ear has fulfilled his obligation

moves.summary: R' Yosei rules that he has not fulfilled his obligation

moves.cueHe: קרא ולא דקדק באותיותיה, רבי יוסי אומר: יצא
moves.summary: one who was imprecise in enunciating the letters has, according to R' Yosei, fulfilled his obligation
moves.about: whether one who recited Shema without being precise in enunciating its letters has fulfilled his obligation

moves.summary: R' Yehuda rules that he has not fulfilled his obligation
one who recited the verses out of order has not fulfilled his obligation
one who erred in his recitation returns to the place where he erred
